SELECT thd.* FROM tpa_homework_details thd,tpa_homework th WHERE thd.hid=th.hid AND th.is_open=1 AND (thd.q_title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR thd.q_type LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR thd.subject LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')) ORDER BY thd.usage_count DESC

SELECT thd.* FROM tpa_homework_details thd,tpa_homework th,tpa_teacher tt WHERE thd.hid=th.hid AND th.author_id=tt.uid AND th.is_open=1 AND tt.teach_stage= #{stage} AND thd.subject LIKE CONCAT('%', #{subject}, '%') OR thd.q_title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{subject}, '%') ORDER BY thd.usage_count DESC

SELECT thd.* FROM tpa_homework_details thd,tpa_preview_task tpt,tpa_teacher tt WHERE thd.pt_id=tpt.pt_id AND tpt.author_id=tt.uid AND tpt.is_open=1 AND tt.teach_stage= #{stage} AND thd.subject LIKE CONCAT('%', #{subject}, '%') OR thd.q_title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{subject}, '%') ORDER BY thd.usage_count DESC
